params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} While [[Combat status|out of combat]], {{ci|Evelynn}} gains ''Demon Shade''.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Demon Shade:}} '''Evelynn''' rapidly {{tip|heals}} while she is {{as|at low health}}. After level 6, ''Demon Shade'' also grants {{tip|camouflage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Evelynn''' shrouds herself in ''Demon Shade'' after not performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}} for 4 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Demon Shade'' immediately and places it on a 4-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}, reduced to {{fd|1.25}} seconds from casting ''{{ai|Last Caress|Evelynn}}''. Taking damage from {{tip|champion|champions}} or {{tip|turret|turrets}} interrupts ''Demon Shade'' and places it on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Demon Shade:}} While below {{as|{{sti|health|{{pplevel|250 to 590}} {{as|(+ 250% AP)}} health}}}}, '''Evelynn''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for {{pplevel|15 to 150|color=heal}} every second. From [[Experience (champion)|level]] 6 onward, ''Demon Shade'' also grants {{tip|camouflage}}.
params.notes:
* ''Demon Shade'' is also placed on a {{fd|1.5}} second cooldown upon {{tip|death|respawning}}.
* ''Demon Shade's'' cooldown incurs upon starting the attack windup of the basic attack and upon the cast time of the ability.
* ''Demon Shade'' activates even if '''Evelynn''' is {{si|Recall|Recalling}}.
* Upon '''Evelynn's''' transition into the stealth, ''Demon Shade'' will interrupt her in-progress cast commands for {{tip|unit-targeted}} spells, excluding ''{{ai|E|Evelynn}}'' and its ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowered}}'' cast.
** If '''Evelynn's''' last issued order was to cast ''{{ai|E|Evelynn}}'', her transition into the stealth will be followed by an automatic command for casting the ability (if no other orders were issued in the meantime).
* Whenever ''Demon Shade'' activates, a puff of purple smoke will briefly appear around her.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Evelynn}} ''curses'' the target enemy, causing her next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} against the target to ''expunge'' the ''curse'', {{tip|slow|slowing}} the target and refunding the {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
params.blurb2:
If the ''curse'' matures long enough, the ''expunge'' will increase the slow, {{tip|charm}} the target, and apply an additional effect based on the target type.
* {{tip|Champions}} have {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|reduced magic resist}}}} for a few seconds.
* {{tip|Monsters}} are dealt {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and increased {{tip|charm}} duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' marks the target enemy {{tip|champion}} or medium or large {{tip|monster}} with a curse for 5 seconds.
params.description2: '''Evelynn's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} hit against the target consumes the mark, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and refunding ''Allure's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}}. If the target was marked for at least {{fd|2.5}} seconds, the consumption is empowered.
params.description3:
{{sbc|Empowered Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|charm|charmed}} for a few seconds and the {{tip|slow}} duration is increased to the same period. Additional effects are also applied based on the target type:
* Against champions, inflicts a {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
* Against monsters, the triggering effect deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and the duration of the {{tip|charm}} is increased by {{fd|2.25}} seconds.
params.description4: ''Casting Allure does not break {{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}} nor its fade into it.''
params.notes:
* The mark fully forming signifies the {{fd|2.5}} seconds have elapsed, meaning the {{tip|charm}} will be applied on the triggering attack or ability.
** An enemy champion cursed by ''Allure'' is alarmed of her presence and after the mark has fully formed, an arrow will appear next to them pointing towards '''Evelynn's''' direction. This is visible to both teams.
* The {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} will be applied to the attack or ability that triggers it.
* ''Allure's'' mark application on a target cannot be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
** The mark's consumption will not occur if the ability is blocked by a spell shield, causing the mark to remain on the target.
* The {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} debuff is applied independently of the {{tip|Charm}} debuff when the matured mark is expunged, meaning a target can still have their magic resistance reduced while they are resisting applications of CC debuffs (e.g. {{cai|Black Shield|Morgana}}).
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time, this ability will cancel but still go on {{sti|cooldown}} and pay its cost.{{bug}}
** ''Allure'' will restart its cooldown whenever the mark debuff is removed.{{bug}}

blurb.plain: Active: Evelynn curses the target enemy, causing her next basic attack or ability against the target to expunge the curse, slowing the target and refunding the mana cost.

blurb2.plain:
If the curse matures long enough, the expunge will increase the slow, charm the target, and apply an additional effect based on the target type.
* Champions have reduced magic resist for a few seconds.
* Monsters are dealt bonus magic damage and increased charm duration.

description.plain: Active: Evelynn marks the target enemy champion or medium or large monster with a curse for 5 seconds.

description2.plain: Evelynn's next basic attack or ability hit against the target consumes the mark, slowing them by 45% for 0.75 seconds and refunding Allure's mana cost. If the target was marked for at least 2.5 seconds, the consumption is empowered.

description3.plain:
Empowered Bonus: The target is charmed for a few seconds and the slow duration is increased to the same period. Additional effects are also applied based on the target type:
* Against champions, inflicts a magic resistance reduction for 4 seconds.
* Against monsters, the triggering effect deals bonus magic damage and the duration of the charm is increased by 2.25 seconds.

description4.plain: Casting Allure does not break Demon Shade nor its fade into it.

params.blurb2: Whenever '''Evelynn''' enters ''{{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}}'', ''Whiplash's'' cooldown will {{sti|ah|reset}} and the next cast is {{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowered}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Evelynn}} casts ''Whiplash'', {{tip|dash|dashing}} to the target enemy and dealing {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} to them and enemies she passes through.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} toward the target enemy with her lashers, dealing {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} to them upon completion as well as to all enemies within her path.
params.leveling: {{st|Empowered Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 4% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
params.description2: ''Empowered Whiplash'' only applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target.
params.notes:
* '''Evelynn''' will track the target if they change locations.
** She will dash to the target's previous location if the target moves {{tt|2000|Estimated}} or more units away.
** She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
* There is no time-out period on ''Empowered Whiplash''.
* ''Empowered Whiplash'' can be {{tip|blocked}} but cannot be {{tip|dodged}} and/or missed if '''Evelynn''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

params.description2: ''Last Caress'' is empowered to deal {{ccs|240% damage|magic}} against enemies below {{as|{{sti|health|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.

* Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} below the health threshold are marked for '''Evelynn''', indicating the target will receive ''Last Caress' '' increased damage.
* The screen will direct to '''Evelynn's''' position after she {{tip|blink|blinks}}.
